coverage: Whole image viewed once, then metadata half a once and half b once, all rotated 180 degrees before their single emitted views. Thus a is the lower upright region and b the upper upright region. All of the page was read: manuscript 19, oppositely oriented archive 26, the left circled glyph, every line of 2.1.1 and 2.2, the abandoned display, five numbered displays, all inline indices and primes, the local hooked graphics, all underline spans, the title and two lower additions, all deletions and overprints, page-wide strokes, and both tiny dots. Every one of the 12 C marks has an outcome; the two unmarked prior questions are also answered. Fourteen unique tight crops were each made and emitted once. No whole or half was reopened; none of the source remains unviewed. H is description only and supplies no textual collation rows. All bboxes use the ORIGINAL unrotated whole scan: upright [x0,y0,x1,y1] maps to [1685-x1,2159-y1,1685-x0,2159-y0]. The already-viewed whole/half derivatives were moved outside the work root without reopening, for packaging compliance.

notes.text: The leaf is a cancelled typescript draft, manuscript page 19, with sections 2.1.1 and 2.2. It contains no date and no total-page count. The separate archive number is 26, oriented oppositely to the typescript. Handwritten additions are not attributed to a named person from this image alone.
notes.basis: Observation: full page and both halves; page header and margins.

notes.text: Section 2.1.1 describes a biextension structure through two partial laws on E, with conditions expressed using pr_2 j and pr_1 j. The second law glyph remains mu/psi from its actual contour. The abandoned equivariance row ends in phi( with no completion. The succeeding display supplies a complete equality chain and the x,y and g conditions.
notes.basis: Source statement, not proof checking: opening paragraph, abandoned row, and (2.1.1.1); crops 02–04.

notes.text: The compatibility display is followed by four fibre labels, read locally as E_{p,q}(S), E_{p,q'}(S), E_{p',q}(S), and E_{p',q'}(S). The two local hooked graphics are reproduced as separate curves. Their meaning is not inferred from the equation.
notes.basis: Observation and source statement: half b and crop 06 at (2.1.1.2) and the following line.

notes.text: The added title reads Sections unité. The two displayed sections are e_{E/P} in Gamma(E/P)=Hom_P(P,E) and e_{E/Q} in Gamma(E/Q)=Hom_Q(Q,E). Each membership sign, Gamma, slash, lower index, and capital in Hom was checked locally. The comma after E in the symmetric prose is retained.
notes.basis: Observation and source statement: half a, crops 07–09; no proof check.

notes.text: The source associates the trivialisations over 1_P times Q and P times 1_Q with e_{E/P} and e_{E/Q}, respectively, exactly as transcribed. It then states that they agree over 1_P times 1_Q and define one section. These associations have not been repaired or independently proved. De plus is typed; a cancelled cursive word survives beneath it; donc is handwritten.
notes.basis: Source statement and visual observation: half a and crops 10–11; no mathematical validation.

notes.text: The live result of the revised final display reads e_E in Gamma(E), followed by a comma. The cancelled lower-index and argument tails are kept independently because the cancellation does not establish one earlier formula. The final prose names section unité and section neutre and ends with on note; no continuation is supplied.
notes.basis: Observation and source statement: (2.2.3), final paragraph, crops 12–13.

notes.text: No mathematical checking was performed in this reader run. Reading equations, noticing their syntax, and preserving the explicitly incomplete expression are transcription activities only; check_events is therefore empty.
notes.basis: Run-level epistemic record; no targeted proof, re-proof, computation, or use-and-recheck occurred.
